newsitems.contents: [h1]New Classic God Nike[/h1][list][*][p]Passive: Hitting an enemy with an ability grants a Laurel to you and allied gods within 10m. [/p][list][*][p]Laurels have a maximum of 3[/p][/*][*][p]An ally consumes a Laurel with an Attack; you Heal them for a small amount scaling with intelligence[/p][/*][*][p]When you attack an enemy, you consume a Laurel, Heal yourself and deal bonus physical damage scaling with strength [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 1:Rend[/p][list][*][p]Slam the ground 3 times, sending fissures forward. Each fissure deals physical damage. [/p][/*][*][p]A target hit twice loses protections for a duration[/p][/*][*][p]A target hit 3 times is disarmed[/p][/*][*][p]You are knockback immune for the duration[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 2: Barrier Formation[/p][list][*][p]Channel a barrier in front of you that blocks ranged basic attacks. Enemies who touch the barrier are knocked back and take physical damage. Reactivate to collapse the barrier, delaying physical damage to enemies in front of you[/p][/*][*][p]Lasts a short duration[/p][/*][*][p]You are knockback immune while channeling[/p][/*][*][p]Your turning is limited, and your movement speed reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Building intelligence reduces the self movement slow. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 3: Valiant Leap[/p][list][*][p]Leap to a target location, dealing physical damage and knocking up enemies where you land[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ultimate Ability: Sentinel of Zeus[/p][list][*][p]Transform into an armored sentinel and send out a shockwave, dealing physical damage and slowing nearby enemies. Gain a shield based on your max health for a duration. [/p][list][*][p]While this buff is active, you do not consume Laurels, but attacks against enemies still heal you and deal bonus physical damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Aspect of Victorious Conquest releasing October 9th[/p][list][*][p]Laurels are granted only to you. At 3 Laurels, your next ability deals bonus physical damage scaling with strength and consumes them. [/p][/*][*][p]Barrier Formation no longer channels; it travels forward 9m, lingers 1s, and knocks up enemies who touch it. [/p][/*][*][p]Valiant leap no longer knocks up. [/p][/*][*][p]Sentinel of Zeus no longer grants a shield; it grants full Laurels, and ability hits do not consume Laurels while newsitems.title: Hel: Race to Radiant!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents: [p]Hel stance swapping elite: You have from Sep 22nd until Sep 29th, 2026, to grind your matches, hit Rank 10, and claim your spot among the elite.[/p][h3]Expanded Leaderboard Rewards[/h3][list][*][p][b]Top 100 Players:[/b] Receive a special Rank 10 Mastery Emblem to display on your profile.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Top 200 Players:[/b] Unlock Hel's exclusive Radiant Mastery Badge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Top 500 Players:[/b] Earn a Special Tracker that permanently displays your exact Race Rank number.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All Players that Reach Rank 10:[/b] Unlock a special Badge.[/p][/*][/list][p]Rewards will be distributed on Sep 30th, 2026. Lock in your games, climb the ranks, and stay tuned for future Gods in the Race to Radiant series![/p]

newsitems.title: Unleash HEL!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[h1]New Classic God: Hel[/h1][p]The Norse Goddess of the Underworld returns with a new model, new voice, new card art, and plus ones![/p][list][*][p]Passive: Stance Attunement[/p][list][*][p]Remain in a stance to become attuned. In Dark Stance, gain increased Damage. In Light Stance, nearby enemy gods lose Strength and Intelligence[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Decay (A01 Dark) [/p][list][*][p]Fire an orb that deals Magical Damage. The orb explodes when it hits an enemy God or reaches maximum range.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Restoration (A01 Light)[/p][list][*][p]Fire an orb that deals Magical Damage. Hitting an ally god Heals them and restores Mana. You Heal and restore Mana whenever you hit an enemy or an Ally God.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hinder (A02 Dark)[/p][list][*][p]Debuff all enemies in the targeted area, reducing their Protections by 5% and Slowing 20% for 3s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cleanse (A02 Light)[/p][list][*][p]Remove all Crowd Control effects from Allied Gods in the target area and briefly make them CC Immune.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Repulse (A03 Dark)[/p][list][*][p]Conjure a burst around you that deals Magical Damage to nearby enemies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Inspire (A03 Light)[/p][list][*][p]You and nearby allies become buffed. newsitems.contents:
[h1]New Classic God: Ravana[/h1][p] [/p][list][*][p]Passive Chain of Blows[/p][list][*][p]Successful attacks and abilities against enemies add to your combo. Each time combo reaches 8, you gain a shield based on your Max Health as well as Movement Speed and Strength. This may stack up to 3 times. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ability 1:Prana Onslaught [/p][list][*][p]Throw a powerful punch, projecting your prana to deal Physical Damage and slow enemies in front of you. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 2:Overhead Kick[/p][list][*][p]Kick high, sending a shockwave forward that deals Physical Damage to all enemies in a line. Gain Movement Speed and become CC immune and Damage Immune for the duration.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 3: 10-Hand Shadow Fist[/p][list][*][p]Fire your fists forward, dealing Physical Damage as they pass through enemies. The first enemy god hit is Rooted. Heal from the first enemy god and the first 3 minions hit. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ultimate Ability: Mystic Rush[/p][list][*][p]Become CC immune and Leap to a target location, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in the area. Enemy Gods hit take increased damage from all sources. After landing, you gain Damage Mitigation for a duration.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Aspect of the Rakshasa King releasing August 28th.[/p][list][*][p]Combo now stacks up to 999. Mystic Rush is replaced by an activator that lets you fire enhanced versions of your regular abilities. The first update will include changes to anti-heal and god healing. The second update will include the enchanter item pass. 

In the next patch we will be increasing anti-heal to 40% for both items and god abilities. The intention is for anti-heal to be powerful and generally accessible. With this change there will also be changes to many gods with healing abilities. The goal with these changes is for gods to fit into 3 main archetypes alongside a gradient for abilities based on how much of the ability is focused on healing vs other effects.[/p][p]Archetype 1 is gods that are generally tanky. These gods will typically have lower base healing with moderate scaling since scaling incurs a defensive tradeoff.[/p][p]Archetype 2 is gods with high damage across their kit. These gods will typically have low to moderate base healing with low to no scaling. These are gods where they have healing in their kit but it is not intended to have a significant impact on their gameplay.[/p][p]Archetype 3 is gods that are not tanky and do not have high sources of damage across their kit. These gods will typically have moderate to high base healing as well as moderate to high scaling.[/p][p]Within these archetypes there are still some differences based on the amount an ability is focused on healing as mentioned above. For example, Chaac Rain Dance will have better healing than Cabrakan Refraction Shield since more of the ability is focused around healing. This pass will also include some changes to better focus some gods and aspects into an enchanter playstyle such as Aphrodite and Eset aspect. Overall we expect healing to be a bit weaker overall into anti-heal but for gods that have healing as a main part of their kit to have access to better scaling options to offset the now stronger anti-heal. This should also be further supported in the second update which will include the enchanter item pass.

newsitems.title: Weave Rainbows with IX CHEL!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents: [h1]New Classic God: Ix Chel[/h1][list][*][p][b] Ix Chel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Passive [/p][/*][*][p]Gain a Rainbow Weaver stack whenever your Abilities hit an enemy god or grant a beneficial effect to an allied god. At 6 stacks, your next Attack has no movement penalty, is larger, travels farther, and deals bonus Magical Damage.[/p][list][*][p]The empowered Attack is spent even if it misses[/p][/*][*][p]The empowered Attack has increased projectile speed and can hit enemy structures from beyond their attack radius.[/p][/*][*][p]The empowered Attack triggers item effects and it benefits from 33% Lifesteal[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 1: Gleaming Blast[/p][list][*][p]Fire a blast of gleaming blast light that deals Base + 60% INT Magic Damage, stopping on the first enemy god hit and transforming this ability into Threads of Light.[/p][/*][*][p]Gleaming Blast deals 40% increased damage to minions and Jungle Camps[/p][/*][*][p]After Gleaming Blast hits an enemy, Threads of Light can be cast immediately.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 1: Alternate: Threads of Light[/p][list][*][p]Illuminate strands in a cone to deal Base + 80% INT Magic Damage. Enemies facing the strands as they illuminate are Blinded for 1s. Enemies hit by the tip of the cone take 25% bonus damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 2: Lunar Invocation[/p][list][*][p]Invoke lunar energy in an area. After a delay, it explodes to deal Magical Damage and Knock Up enemies, while also Healing allies[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 3: Rainbow Crash[/p][list][*][p]Fire an arcing rainbow and gain Movement Speed. When it lands, deal Magical Damage and Root enemies. The rainbow splits into 6 orbs that you and allied gods can pick up to gain Movement Speed.[/p][list][*][p]You can benefit from the initial buff and an orb for Movement Speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Orbs can bounce off walls up to 2 times. Each allied god can pick up only 1 orb per cast.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ultimate Ability: The Great End[/p][list][*][p]Become CC Immune and channel a rainbow beam. Magical Damage and allied gods Heal. Damaging an enemy god or Healing an allied god also Heals you.[/p][list][*][p]Simultaneously hitting an enemy god and allied god extends the channel.[/p][/*][*][p]Repeated hits deal increased damage per tick, this bonus begins decaying incrementally after a delay of not being hit[/p][/*][*][p]Firing the beam grants 6 Rainbow Weaver stacks; if you already have 6, gain Echo for the duration[/p][/*][*][p]You can move freely in all directions without a backpedal penalty while channeling.[/p][/*][*][p]You Heal only once per tick, regardless of how many allied gods you Heal or enemy gods you damage.[/p][/*][*][p]You can only Heal up to 30% of your Maximum Health[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Aspect of the Mother’s Light releasing August 14th[/p][list][*][p]Role swap towards Support[/p][/*][*][p]Gleaming Blast and the Great End no longer deal damage. [/p][/*][*][p]Gleaming Blast now shields ally gods and slows enemy gods. [/p][/*][*][p]Lunar Invocation and the Great End have greatly increased healing.[/p][/*][*][p]Passive, Threads of Light, and Rainbow Crash unchanged [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h1]New newsitems.title: Ix Chel: Race to Radiant!

newsitems.contents: [p]Ix Chel mains: You have from July 28th until Aug 18th, 2026, to grind your matches, hit Rank 10, and claim your spot among the elite.[/p][h3]Expanded Leaderboard Rewards[/h3][list][*][p][b]Top 100 Players:[/b] Receive a special Rank 10 Mastery Emblem to display on your profile.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Top 200 Players:[/b] Unlock Ix Chel's exclusive Radiant Mastery Badge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Top 500 Players:[/b] Earn a Special Tracker that permanently displays your exact Race Rank number.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All Players that Reach Rank 10:[/b] Unlock a special Badge.[/p][/*][/list][p]Rewards will be distributed on Aug 19th, 2026. Lock in your games, climb the ranks, and stay tuned for future Gods in the Race to Radiant series![/p]

newsitems.contents: [h1]New Classic God Cu Chulainn[/h1][list][*][p][b] Cu Chulainn[/b][/p][list][*][p]Passive Berserk[/p][list][*][p]Your Mana, Mana regen and mana heals convert into your health pool instead of Mana. Abilities cost Rage, which only regenerates up to 25. [/p][/*][*][p]After building high Rage, you go Berserk for a duration gaining strength and a health shield. While Berserk, your abilities transform and cost no Rage. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 1:Barbed Spear[/p][list][*][p]Thrust your spear forward dealing physical damage to enemies in front of you stunning weaker minions. Barbs reduce healing received for a duration. [/p][/*][*][p]Berserk- Ground Slam[/p][list][*][p]Slam your arms down, dealing physical damage rooting enemies in front of you.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 2:Vent Anger[/p][list][*][p]Vent Superheated steam for a duration, gaining movement speed and dealing physical damage to nearby enemies repeatedly. This drains your rage and returns none. [/p][/*][*][p]Berserk: Vent Anger activates automatically and does not drain rage. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 3: Salmon’s Leap[/p][list][*][p]Leap to a target location and slam down, dealing physical damage to enemies around and in front of you. [/p][/*][*][p]Berserk - Furious Charge: Charge forward, dealing physical damage, stunning enemies and driving them back with you.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ultimate Ability: Spear of Mortal Pain[/p][list][*][p]Swing Gae Bulg in a circle around you, dealing physical damage and knocking up all enemies nearby. You are CC immune while channeling. [/p][/*][*][p]Berserk - Wary Cry: unleash a terrifying yell, dealing physical damage and trembling all nearby enemies. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Aspect of the Warped releasing July 31st[/p][list][*][p]Start the Berserk. Vent Anger now costs rage when berserk. After reaching 100 rage, become Warped gaining massive power, losing rage every .5s. After reaching 0 rage transforms back to human form with reduced protections and damage.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Cu Chullain's Race to Radiant runs from July 28 through Aug. 4.[/p][p]Odin's Race to Exalted runs from Aug. 4 through Aug. 11[/p][p] [/p][h1]New Cosmetics[/h1][p]The Silkshade Da Ji, Hot Diggity Odin, and Corroded Colossus Atlas Travelers, as well as the Summer Quip Bundle and a special Devil Dog Jump Stamp, are available as part of a special event purchase: The Summer Fun Bundle. newsitems.contents: [p]Hotdog! It's a 2x Worshiper weekend![/p][p][/p][p]Play SMITE 2 from 12:30 a.m. EDT July 3rd - 12:30 p.m. EDT July 6th and earn 2x Worshipers![/p][p][/p][p]There's no better time to take your favorite god to Radiant. Ka-boom baby![/p]

newsitems.title: Beat the Clock: Chronos Race to Radiant is On!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents: [p]The Keeper of Time has arrived, and the race to the top of the leaderboards is officially on! Prove your dedication by playing Chronos and reaching Mastery Rank 10. The competition is fierce, and only the fastest players will secure the exclusive rewards available for this event.[/p][p]You have until July 7th, 2026, to grind your matches, hit Rank 10, and claim your spot among the elite. But don't worry: We've expanded the rewards from last Race, so even more players can participate![/p][h3]Expanded Leaderboard Rewards[/h3][list][*][p][b]Top 100 Players:[/b] Receive a special Rank 10 Mastery Emblem to display on your profile.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Top 200 Players:[/b] Unlock Chronos' exclusive Radiant Mastery Badge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Top 500 Players:[/b] Earn a Special Tracker that permanently displays your exact Race Rank number.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All Players that Reach Rank 10:[/b] Unlock a special Badge.[/p][/*][/list][p]Rewards will be distributed on July 7th, 2026. Lock in your games, climb the ranks, and stay tuned for future Gods in the Race to Radiant series![/p]

newsitems.title: IT'S TIME... FOR CHRONOS!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath

[h1]New Classic God: Chronos[/h1][list][*][p]Passive: Time Lord[/p][list][*][p]You become empowered as time flows around you. Over time you gain Intelligence. Stacks have a maximum and are permanent. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 1: Time Rift[/p][list][*][p]Create a rift in time that deals magical damage to all enemies in the area. Hitting a god permanently increases the Time Rift damage by 1. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 2: Accelerate[/p][list][*][p]Accelerate yourself for a duration. You gain Movement Speed (initial plus increasing over time) and increased Attack Speed. While Accelerate is active, the Wheel of Time stops; the quadrant it stopped on determines which bonus you receive:[/p][list][*][p]Section 1: Heal based on your max health over time[/p][/*][*][p]Section 2: Abilities cost no Mana[/p][/*][*][p]Section 3: Increased Intelligence[/p][/*][*][p]Section 4: Increased Intelligence contribution to your attacks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 3: Stop Time[/p][list][*][p]Fire spinning gears of time forward. Enemies hit have their Attack Speed reduced, ramping into a Stun. They Take Magical Damage on impact and Magical Damage when Stunned. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Ultimate Ability: Teleport through time to a recent position, restoring your Health and mana to their earlier values. Enemy gods hit grant strength and are revealed to you for a duration. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 1: Pounce[/p][list][*][p]Leap to a target location dealing physical damage to enemies in the area. For a short duration, reactivate to leap back to your initial location. You gain increased movement speed while you can return.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 2: Razor Whip[/p][list][*][p]Swipe at enemies in a cone, causing them to bleed for physical damage over time. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 3: Ensnaring Claw[/p][list][*][p]Send a cat forward. If it hits an enemy, it roots them and nearby enemies briefly and deals physical damage. The cat persists for a duration or until defeated, attacking nearby enemies for physical damage and applying a slow. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Ultimate Ability: Cat Call[/p][list][*][p]Summon 3 spirit cats that follow you and attack nearby enemies for a duration. Components:[/p][p][i]Strength giving component items are being tuned down this patch. The goal here is to reduce early game in-hand power a bit, while keeping lategame power at about the same level. Across the board, Smite 2’s gods have higher basic attack power, and strength items were also giving quite a bit more power per cost towards inhands.[/i] [/p][p] [/p][p]Axe[/p][list][*][p]Strength reduced from 10 to 5[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Skeggox[/p][list][*][p]Strength reduced from 25 to 15[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Lucerne Hammer[/p][list][*][p]Strength reduced from 35 to 20[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Transcendence[/p][list][*][p]Max Mana reduced from 400 to 250[/p][/*][*][p]Mana per stack is now a shared buff with Book of Thoth called Mana Infusion that grants 10 mana per stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Mana Infusion has a max stack count of 50.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Book of Thoth[/p][list][*][p]Mana per stack is now a shared buff with Transcendance called Mana Infusion that grants 10 mana per stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Mana Infusion has a max stack count of 50.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Blinking Abyss[/p][p][i]Blinking Abyss is an item we are still going to keep a close watch on. While we feel that most players enjoy being able to reposition in combat, the cost and stats the item provides were not really a tradeoff at all, and its ability to be used to escape by backliners was happening a bit too often.  The cooldown change here increases the cooldown when the damage component doesn’t hit, but the cooldown remains the same when Blinking Abyss is used aggressively.  Notably, we are not increasing the cooldown of the Blink Relic with this change either.[/i][/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Cost increased from 1250 to 1350[/p][/*][*][p]All stats from Items reduced from 6% to 5%[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown increased from 170 to 200[/p][/*][*][p]Damage decreased from 150 + 30% of Strength and Intelligence to 25 + 10% of Strength and Intelligence.[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown Reduction from hitting an enemy target with followup damage increased from -35s to -65s[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Breastplate of Valor[/p][list][*][p]Healing no longer counts towards reduced cooldowns.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Heartwood Charm:[/p][list][*][p]Passive and Active have been Redesigned, now:[/p][list][*][p]20% reduced cooldown for healing abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]When you heal with abilities, 20% of that healing is copied into the Charm, up to 350 healing.  [/p][/*][*][p]On use: Heal all allies around you equal to the amount stored in the Charm.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Plating and Dampening:[/p][p][i]We’re revisiting Plating and Dampening as stats in this patch. Initially, we wanted to give Plating and Dampening items fairly high amounts of their own mitigation on each item picked up, allowing you to flex to counter certain types of attacks by buying them.  However, because of how these played with protections and mitigation already, that meant we couldn’t put much protections on items that had them, if at all.  And that made these items less attractive to pick up in a build.  

Instead, we’re moving to reducing Plating and Dampening on individual items, but combining them with protections.  Meaning you’ll get less of these stats from each item you buy, but you’ll get more universal defenses with them, allowing you to build up your Plating and Dampening stats through a game.  Along with that, because there are less Plating and Dampening items in general, we’re adding the stats to older items that previously didn’t have them as well.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Chandra’s Grace[/p][list][*][p]Now has 5 Plating[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Doublet Of Binding[/p][list][*][p]Old[/p][list][*][p]15 Dampening[/p][/*][*][p]400 Max Health[/p][/*][*][p]On Use: Gain a Protective Link to a target.[/p][/*][*][p]Protective Link redirects 20% of Damage they take, up to 600 Health.[/p][/*][*][p]This Damage is mitigated by your Dampening[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown 45s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New[/p][list][*][p]5 Dampening[/p][/*][*][p]200 Max Health[/p][/*][*][p]50 Magical Protection[/p][/*][*][p]On Use: Gain a Protective Link to a target.[/p][/*][*][p]Protective Link redirects 20% of Damage they take, up to 600 Health.[/p][/*][*][p]This Damage is mitigated by your Dampening[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown 45s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Now Builds from Veve Charm + Circle of Protection[/p][/*][*][p]Cost increased by 150g - Now 2700 gold[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Kinetic Cuirass[/p][list][*][p]Old[/p][list][*][p]15 Plating[/p][/*][*][p]300 Max Health[/p][/*][*][p]Damaged by 3 attacks from gods: Gain Kinetic. EFG’s stats are now more in line with normal Fire Giant.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Fire Giant’s additional Max Health while Enhanced (was +4000)[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Fire Giant’s additional Strength while Enhanced +85 -> +40[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Moonlight[/p][list][*][p]A few changes to make both the middle objective and the race to collect shards more competitive…[/p][list][*][p]Lowered the cap on the number of Shards collected, and made it possible for teams to tie and both get Lane Pushers[/p][/*][*][p]The Ritual Site at the center of the map now functions similar to how Beacon did in Smite 1, with a couple tweaks. [h1][b]New Classic God: Atlas[/b][/h1][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Passive: The Astrolobe[/p][list][*][p]You gain Energy in your Astrolabe when you take damage from enemy gods or deal damage with your Basic Attacks or Abilities (minions grant reduced Energy). At enough Energy, you may press your Interact key to unleash an Empowered Astrolabe Strike, consuming Energy. This does not trigger automatically from your next Basic Attack. [/p][list][*][p]Empowered Astrolabe Strikes deal Basic Attack Damage + 8 Bonus Damage per Level in an area, with increased swing time; enemy gods are Trembled and minions are Stunned[/p][/*][*][p]While your Astrolabe is deployed with Unburden, your Empowered Astrolabe Strike resolves at the Astrolabe's location, dealing 3 times Basic Attack Damage to enemies around it[/p][/*][*][p]While you are holding your Astrolabe, Empowered Astrolabe Strikes damage enemies in front of you [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 1: Unburden[/p][list][*][p]Throw your Astrolabe to a target location, dealing Magical Damage and Slowing enemies for 2s. While deployed, your Basic Attacks cause explosions at the Astrolabe that deal Magical Damage to enemies and cost Mana per explosion. After 5s or when you refire, the Astrolabe returns.[/p][/*][*][p]While the Astrolabe is deployed, gain Bonus Movement Speed[/p][/*][*][p]Gravity Pull changes based on whether your Astrolabe is deployed or held[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 2:.Gravity Pull [/p][list][*][p]Pull enemies toward your Astrolabe. Enemy gods who are too close are pulled into it. If you are holding your Astrolabe, you become Knock Up Immune, and enemies pulled into the Astrolabe are held in front of you before being launched in the direction you are facing. If your Astrolabe is deployed, held enemies are launched toward you from its location. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Ability 3: Kinetic Charge[/p][list][*][p]Dash forward, dealing Magical Damage to minions and cleansing yourself of Slows. Each allied god you pass near is cleansed of Slows and gains Movement Speed. While dashing, you are Slow and Knock Up Immune. Hitting an enemy god releases an explosion that Slows; each Slow you cleanse from an ally during the dash strengthens that explosion's Slow, up to a maximum. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]Ultimate Ability: Gamma Ray Burst[/p][list][*][p]Tear open the sky and call down a Gamma-Ray Burst. Enemies in the area take Magical Damage over time and gain Radiation stacks that reduce their Protections and Power. After 5s or when you refire, the burst focuses into a traveling beam that deals heavier damage and applies Focused Radiation. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Aspect of the Unburdened releasing May 8th. [/p][list][*][p]Your basic attack now throws your astrolabe. Unburden is used to reposition the astrolabe. Gravity no longer pulls when the astrolabe is deployed. Kinetic Charge can be used to kick the astrolabe forward. Your passive now reduces the cooldown of Gamma-Ray Burst. [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h1]New Cosmetics[/h1][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Classic Traveler: High Noon Sylvanus[/b][/p][p align="start"]Part of the Tracker Syndicate event.[/p][p align="start"]Contents[/p][list][*][p]Instantly unlocked after purchasing the Premium Traveler Page[/p][/*][*][p]Premium Page Contents - Unlock the following items with Wandering Market Coins[/p][list][*][p]Alebrije Prism[/p][/*][*][p]Tendril Dredge Prism[/p][/*][*][p]El Tree-ablo Prism[/p][/*][*][p]High Noon Ward Skin[/p][/*][*][p]Tracker Pact Token (part of the Tracker Syndicate Event)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Classic Traveler: Dark Lord Zeus[/b][/p][p align="start"]Part of the Tracker Syndicate event.[/p][p align="start"]Contents[/p][list][*][p]Instantly unlocked after purchasing the Premium Traveler Page[/p][/*][*][p]Premium Page Contents - Unlock the following items with Wandering Market Coins[/p][list][*][p]Crimson Core Prism[/p][/*][*][p]Ivory Prime Prism[/p][/*][*][p]Phantom Flux Prism[/p][/*][*][p]White Lightning Jump Stamp[/p][/*][*][p]Tracker Pact Token (part of the Tracker Syndicate Event)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]New Skin: Burning Passion Aphrodite[/b][/p][list][*][p]Available in the Burning Passion Chest, or via direct purchase.
 [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]New Twitch Drop Skin: Flurry Ratatoskr[/b][/p][list][*][p]Available free as a Twitch Drop, starting May 9.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]

newsitems.title: Ishtar Ignites the Battleground | Love and War Update
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents: [p]War has a new goddess.[/p][p][b]Ishtar, Goddess of Love and War, enters SMITE 2[/b]—bringing flexible, high-skill ranged combat with her signature arrow stances. Adapt on the fly with explosive volleys, rapid-fire pressure, or wide cone attacks, and punish enemies with devastating crowd control and mobility.[/p][p]But this update doesn’t just add a god—it [b]reshapes how SMITE 2 is played.[/b][/p][h3]⚔️ Conquest Reforged — Fight Back From Behind[/h3][p]This patch delivers a [b]major pacing overhaul[/b] designed to stop runaway snowballs and create real comeback potential:[/p][list][*][p][b]Dynamic Jungle XP:[/b] Kill higher-level camps to catch up faster[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lane XP Scaling:[/b] Behind? You gain bonus XP from lane minions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Bounties:[/b] Taking down fed enemies is more rewarding than ever[/p][/*][*][p][b]Objective Rewards Reworked:[/b] More local power, less passive global snowball[/p][/*][/list][p]If you're winning, you'll still have a meaningful advantage. But if you’re losing, you now have [b]real paths back into the game.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌿 Jungle Power Reined In[/h3][p]Junglers no longer control the entire map by default:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced camp rewards and farming efficiency[/p][/*][*][p]Pathfinder buff reworked (less burst, less mobility)[/p][/*][*][p]Harder neutral objectives require real commitment[/p][/*][/list][p]The result: [b]more balanced map impact across every role.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]💥 Economy & Map Impact Changes[/h3][p]Victory now goes to the players making plays—not teamwide passive gains:[/p][list][*][p]Towers and bosses now reward [b]local players, not team-wide [/b][/p][/*][*][p]Jungle gold pickups are no longer team-wide[/p][/*][*][p]Objective control matters: [b]Who does it—not just that it happens[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]One winning lane won't snowball the entire map anymore.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🆕 New God: Ishtar[/h3][p]Master three combat styles with [b]Imbue Arrows[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Strike Shot[/b] – explosive AoE pressure[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spread Shot[/b] – cone burst with on-hit synergy[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storm Shot[/b] – rapid-fire ranged DPS[/p][/*][/list][p]Lock down enemies with lightning, dash in with blade combos, and finish with [b]Blades of Retribution[/b], a devastating two-phase ultimate.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔥 New Ishtar Aspect (April 24) — Passionate Storm[/h3][p]Turn Ishtar into a relentless, jungle-focused DPS machine:[/p][list][*][p]Permanent Spread Shot[/p][/*][*][p]Build Storm stacks, then consume them with your 3 for burst damage[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎁 Tracker Syndicate: New Travelers & Rewards[/h3][list][*][p]Mystic Enchantress Nu Wa[/p][/*][*][p]Shadowrunner Ratatoskr[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ System & Gameplay Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Critical strike damage reduced[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Tenacity improved[/b] to counter more CC effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fatalis properly affects Aspects and Abilities that change a god from Melee to Ranged[/p][/*][*][p]Dagger of Frenzy stacks are used by Abilities that benefit from its attack speed[/p][/*][*][p]Party queue reliability improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple QoL and gameplay refinements[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]And So Much More[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Balance changes across gods and items[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes and gameplay polish across all modes[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Play SMITE 2 now.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]For full patch notes, visit [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-33-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-33-update-notes/[/url][/p]

newsitems.title: Ratatoskr Scampers Into SMITE 2 | The Ratatoskr Update
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p][b]The Battleground just got faster, trickier, and a whole lot more chaotic.[/b][/p][p]Ratatoskr leaps into SMITE 2, bringing a unique playstyle built around [b]customizable acorns[/b] that evolve your abilities mid-match. Choose your upgrade path and adapt on the fly—whether you want mobility, burst, or control, Ratatoskr delivers.[/p][list][*][p][b]Dash, crit, and reset fights[/b] with Dart[/p][/*][*][p][b]Control space and shred protections[/b] with Flurry[/p][/*][*][p][b]Burst and stun enemies[/b] with Acorn Blast[/p][/*][*][p][b]Traverse the map like never before[/b] with Through the Cosmos[/p][/*][/list][p]And with the [b]Aspect of the Thickbark (April 10)[/b], Ratatoskr’s acorns evolve even further—enhancing your abilities with new effects like knockbacks, extra projectiles, healing, and defensive power.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]New Event: Tracker Syndicate[/b][/h3][p]Track everything. Flex everything.[/p][p]Introducing [b]Tracker Syndicate[/b], a brand-new progression event packed with rewards and customization:[/p][list][*][p][b]6 Travelers[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]3 NEW Tracker Collections[/b] featuring 20 trackers each[/p][/*][*][p][b]Account Trackers[/b] – usable on any god[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aspect Trackers[/b] – track Aspect gameplay moments[/p][/*][/list][p]Earn trackers, cosmetics, Diamonds, and more as you complete collections and show off your achievements.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Last Chance: Reign of the Archfiend[/b][/h3][p]This is your [b]final opportunity[/b] to unlock:[/p][list][*][p]The Archfiend Saga[/p][/*][*][p]Grovebound Mordred[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus rewards and discounted bundles[/p][/*][/list][p]After this update, content will still be available—but [b]without the event bonuses[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Leaver penalties improved[/b] – returning players are treated more fairly[/p][/*][*][p][b]High Priority requeue[/b] after dodged lobbies for faster matchmaking[/p][/*][*][p]Continued balance updates across gods and items[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]And So Much More[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Bug fixes and polish across abilities and UI[/p][/*][*][p]Item tuning and balance updates[/p][/*][*][p]Continued improvements to matchmaking and systems[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Upgrade your acorn. Track your legacy. Cause chaos.[/b][/p][p]
[b]Play the Ratatoskr Update now.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Full update notes are available here: [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-32-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-32-update-notes/[/url][/p]

newsitems.title: Drop Kicks & Domination. | The Gilgamesh Update
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p][b]The King of Heroes has arrived—and he’s bringing the fight with him.[/b][/p][p]Gilgamesh enters SMITE 2 with a unique progression system that transforms how you play mid-match. Complete in-game quests tied to your abilities to unlock powerful upgrades, earn bonus gold, and push your advantage as the battle unfolds. Every fight brings you closer to your next power spike—if you can rise to the challenge.[/p][p]His kit is built for domination:[/p][list][*][p][b]Drop Kick enemies into walls or gods[/b] to set up devastating combos[/p][/*][*][p][b]Control space with Winds of Shamash[/b], trapping enemies in a deadly arena[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leap, chase, and disrupt[/b] with relentless pressure and mobility[/p][/*][/list][p]And with the [b]Aspect of Shamash (dropping March 27)[/b], Gilgamesh evolves even further—transforming his ultimate into a standard ability. This new wind wall can be empowered by his other three abilities, becoming burning flame, impassable rock, or a breezy launch pad.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Item System Evolution[/b][/h3][p]A new era of buildcraft begins.[/p][p]This update introduces [b]entirely new item stats and mechanics[/b] that reshape how you build and play:[/p][list][*][p][b]Plating[/b] – Mitigate incoming attack damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dampening[/b] – Mitigate incoming ability damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Echo[/b] – Critical strike for abilities[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pathfinding[/b] – Out-of-combat Move Speed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tenacity[/b] – Crowd Control Reduction[/p][/*][/list][p]With brand-new items and reworked classics, build diversity is deeper than ever—and every choice matters.[/p][list][*][p][b]Radiant Bulwark[/b] – Deploy a wall that shares your defenses with allies behind you[/p][/*][*][p][b]Doublet of Binding[/b] – Link to an ally and redirect damage to yourself[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kinetic Cuirass[/b] – Unleash a shockwave after taking sustained hits[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wyrmskin Hide[/b] – Ramp up Dampening against targets you’re fighting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alchemist Coat[/b] – Generate free consumables and gain bonuses from using them[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mercury’s Talaria[/b] – Store movement energy to massively boost your next ability[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolute Mantle[/b] – Gain stacking Tenacity and regen after being crowd controlled[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shroud of Vengeance[/b] – Punish CC with a damaging shockwave[/p][/*][*][p][b]Damaru[/b] – Weave crits and abilities together for stacking bonus damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Omen Drum[/b] – Echo a portion of your ability damage across all marked enemies[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]A Better Battleground: Anti-Leaver 2.0 (Phase 1)[/b][/h3][p]Competitive integrity takes a major step forward.[/p][p]This update introduces the first phase of [b]Anti-Leaver 2.0[/b], designed to reduce match disruption and reward players who stay in the fight:[/p][list][*][p]Leaver Points track dodges and abandons across matches[/p][/*][*][p]Low Priority Queue penalties scale with repeated offenses[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AFK detection and enforcement[/p][/*][*][p]Clear in-game messaging and accountability systems[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning—future updates will continue to evolve this system.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]New Travelers & Rewards[/b][/h3][p]Expand your collection with new Wandering Market Travelers:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fiend Hunters Artio & Tsukuyomi[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Warrenborn Artemis[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Earn cosmetics, prisms, and rewards as part of the ongoing [b]Reign of the Archfiend[/b] event.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]And So Much More[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tower targeting responsiveness improved[/p][/*][*][p]Arena and Assault pacing adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]New bots and AI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Major bug fixes and balance updates across the roster[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Forge your legend. Complete the trials. Become the King of Heroes.[/b]
[b]Play the Gilgamesh Update now.

Full update notes are available here: [/b][url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-31-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-31-update-notes/[/url][/p]

newsitems.title: CHARON PADDLES INTO BATTLE!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]On March 10, the river has a new master.[/p][p][b]Charon arrives in SMITE 2[/b], bringing one of the most unique support playstyles in the Battleground’s history. Collect coins from fallen minions and monsters to build Soul stacks (earning infinitely scaling health), ferry allies across the map in your spectral boat, and unleash the power of the River Styx.[/p][p]Control fights witha silencing [b]Spectral Surge[/b], reveal enemies and empower allies through [b]Damnation[/b], paddle into battle with [b]Swift Voyage[/b], and summon a massive tidal wave with [b]Summon Styx[/b], fearing enemies while empowering allies behind the wave.[/p][p]On [b]March 13[/b], Charon’s [b]Aspect of the Tollkeeper[/b] arrives, transforming his playstyle into a scaling damage engine. Coins are automatically drawn toward you, scaling your power. Damnation leaves an orbit skull that attacks marked enemies, and your abilities trigger waves of follow-up strikes. The trade-off: No more silence or shielding.[/p][p]Whether ferrying allies into battle or controlling the river of souls, Charon brings an entirely new way to support your team.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]The Massive Base Stat Overhaul[/h2][p]This update introduces one of the [b]largest gameplay shakeups in SMITE 2 so far[/b].[/p][p]To restore stronger god identity and create more meaningful builds, we’re introducing a sweeping base stat rebalance across the entire roster.[/p][p]Every god now has [b]one standout base stat[/b] that reinforces their identity and playstyle.[/p][p]This also dramatically changes early laning:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mana regeneration has been reduced across the roster[/b], making mana management far more important.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mana items and mana regeneration matter again.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Solo lane Totem fights become more valuable[/b], since mana sustain can decide early pressure.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Melee bruisers and tanks gain more attack damage[/b], helping them trade into ranged casters and healer supports.[/p][/*][/list][p]The result is a battlefield where [b]build choices matter more, matchups feel more distinct, and gods once again have stronger identities.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Match Boosters Arrive[/h2][p]A new way to accelerate progression enters SMITE 2.[/p][p][b]Match Boosters[/b] grant [b]2x XP and Worshipers for both teams for one match[/b] and can be activated by one player on each side.[/p][p]Use them to level gods faster, help your team progress, and make every match count.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Assault Improvements[/h2][p]Assault receives a large round of quality-of-life improvements focused on pacing and team fights:[/p][list][*][p]Wider lanes near towers[/p][/*][*][p]Faster match start[/p][/*][*][p]Increased minion spawn and scaling frequency[/p][/*][*][p]Larger assist range for team play[/p][/*][*][p]Improved camera collision along map edges[/p][/*][*][p]Custom lobbies now support [b]All Pick Assault[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]New Wandering Market Travelers[/h2][p]Two new Travelers join the [b]Reign of the Archfiend[/b] event:[/p][p][b]Loki Charms – Loki[/b]
A magician-themed skin featuring multiple Prism variations and cosmetics.[/p][p][b]The Magnificent – Sol[/b]
A dazzling stage performer with elegant Prism skins and themed rewards.[/p][p]Both Travelers grant [b]Wyrm Seals[/b] toward Archfiend event progression.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]And So Much More[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Setting:[/b] Show ability targeters during the prefire window when using Instant Cast.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extensive Balance Changes:[/b] Adjustments across gods, items, and starter upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Conquest Tuning:[/b] Updates to Inspiration (Purple Buff) stacking and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arena Improvements:[/b] Updated crowd audio mix and pacing adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality-of-Life Updates:[/b] Purchase modals now show your currency totals for clearer spending decisions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay Fixes:[/b] Addressed CC indicator issues, ability behavior bugs, and interaction inconsistencies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Fixes for Susano ability issues, Hou Yi effects persisting, and more.[/p][/*][/list][p]Full update notes are available here: [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-30-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-30-update-notes/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The Ferryman waits.[/p][p]Step aboard and see how the Battleground has changed.
[b]Play SMITE 2 now.[/b][/p]

newsitems.title: Morgan Le Fay Arrives & Arena Visual Update
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]Power bends. Magic fractures. The Dark Enchantress has arrived.[/p][p][b]Morgan Le Fay joins SMITE 2[/b], bringing layered spellcraft, sigil selection, and escalating power into every fight. Mark enemies with five unique Symbols to trigger Empowered Blade, reduce cooldowns, gain Intelligence, and scale permanently throughout the match.[/p][p]Choose your magic in real time with [b]Sigil Mastery[/b], summon dragons with knockup and knockback pressure, punish movement with Shroud of Wildfire, and unleash [b]Consuming Power[/b], a devastating CC immune ultimate that grows stronger based on the variety of Marks consumed.[/p][p]On [b]February 27[/b], her [b]Aspect of the Cursed Crown[/b] arrives, transforming her into a melee battlemage. Gain Wrath over time, fire all three Sigils at once in a Venn diagram of doom, and unleash a two-stage ultimate at 40 or 80 Wrath. This Aspect trades ranged safety for close-range devastation and Max Health-scaling explosions.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Adaptive Starters & Conquest Role Buffs Are Here[/h2][p]Starter items have been fundamentally reworked to provide [b]Adaptive Stats[/b], intelligently granting Strength or Intelligence based on your build. This opens hybrid paths, enables flexible itemization, and reshapes early-game decisions across every role.[/p][p]Role-specific bonuses have also been introduced in Conquest, giving Support, Jungle, Solo, Mid, and Carry distinct identity advantages throughout the match. The two systems combine make more starters viable than ever for Junglers and Supports.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Arena After Dark[/h2][p]Arena receives a dramatic visual overhaul:[/p][list][*][p]New stadium-themed night lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Order vs Chaos spotlight presentation[/p][/*][*][p]Updated ground and sky materials[/p][/*][*][p]Atmospheric fog and environmental touches[/p][/*][/list][p]The Battleground has never looked more intense.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Multiqueue Expanded[/h2][p]Multiqueue now allows players to select exactly which modes they want to queue for:[/p][p]Conquest
Arena
Joust
Assault[/p][p]Regional optimizations improve matchmaking quality and reduce wait times across supported regions.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Wandering Market Travelers[/h2][p]Midnight Glamour Neith
Jandroid Janus[/p][p]Both include Wyrm Seals for progression in the Archfiend Saga event.[/p][p]A new Reward Traveler also arrives:[/p][p][b]Grovebound Mordred[/b], unlocked after collecting 6 Wyrm Seals.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]And So Much More[/h2][list][*][p][b]Updated God Screen[/b]
Now clearly shows Physical or Magical damage types and adds a small icon view option.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Support Access[/b]
New out-of-game Escape Menu buttons link directly to Support and Bug Reporting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crowd Control Clarity Fixes[/b]
Ability icons now properly X out when affected by CC. Fixed lingering CC immunity visuals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death Metal Rework[/b]
Converts Intelligence into Strength during its effect and increases Crit Chance to 20%. No longer buffs allies or grants Attack Speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lobby & Store Stability Fixes[/b]
Fixed god models not loading, item store selection issues, and controller Aspect selection bugs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arena & UI Fixes[/b]
Colorblind Minotaur indicators fixed. Mastery stars now display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay Bug Fixes[/b]
Hou Yi interruption corrected, bot knockups fixed, Danza camera issue resolved, and various VFX/ability issues cleaned up.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Magic is changing. Builds are evolving. The Battleground is darker than ever.[/p][p]Step into the crown.
Play SMITE 2 now.[/p][p][/p][p]Full update notes are available here: [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-29-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-29-update-notes/[/url][/p]

newsitems.title: Forever Alone? Or Always Mine?
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents: [p]This Valentine’s weekend, SMITE 2 celebrates the season with a limited-time event that lets you define your relationship status on the Battleground.[/p][p]Earn exclusive rewards based on how you play:[/p][list][*][p][b]Play more games in a party[/b] to unlock the [b]Always Mine[/b] badge[/p][/*][*][p][b]Play more games solo[/b] to claim the coveted [b]Forever Alone[/b] badge[/p][/*][/list][p]No matter your path, everyone benefits from [b]2x Worshipers[/b], making this the perfect weekend to level gods, grind mastery, and jump into matches with friends or rivals.[/p][p]The event also features the arrival of [b]Heartguard Athena[/b], bringing sharp style and sharper shields to the fight, plus new [b]Themed Supporter Store Bundles[/b] to match the mood.[/p][p]Whether you’re queueing together, flying solo, or somewhere in between, this weekend is about proving your status in combat.[/p][p]This event runs from 7 a.m. Eastern on Friday, Feb. 13 to 11 a.m. Eastern on Tuesday, Feb. 17. Badge rewards will be distributed up to 2 days following the conclusion of the event.[/p]

newsitems.title: Ne Zha Returns & Anti-Heal is Back!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]The Third Lotus Prince rises again on Tuesday, Feb. 10, bringing one of SMITE’s most iconic gods into a bold new era.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/bcdcddd4b39ec6bb697f9d656355de8d4358545e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Ne Zha returns to SMITE 2[/b] with a fully rebuilt model, an all-new voice pack, meaningful kit updates, and a new gameplay identity built around speed, momentum, and high-impact critical strikes. Generate Righteous Spirit through constant pressure, chain together precise combos, and turn every fight into a test of execution. On February 13, his [b]Aspect of the Righteous Flame[/b] goes live, offering a powerful alternate playstyle that transforms Ne Zha into a sustain-focused brawler who empowers allies and punishes overextensions.[/p][h3]Ne Zha Kit Highlights[/h3][list][*][p][b]Righteous Spirit (Passive)[/b]
Build stacks by staying in combat to gain Movement Speed. [b]+1: [/b]Gaining a stack permanently increases Critical Strike Damage. This can theoretically scale infinitely.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Universe Ring Toss (Ability 1)[/b]
Throw a bouncing ring that damages enemies, applies Physical Protection reduction, and Slows. [b]+1: [/b]You can catch the returning ring for an additional throw that doesn't bounce, but does crit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flaming Spear (Ability 2)[/b]
Ignite your spear to gain Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance while healing based on Righteous Spirit stacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Armillary Sash (Ability 3)[/b]
Stun and pull yourself to the first enemy god hit, setting up high-damage combos and ult confirms.
[b]+1:[/b] This ability can now Crit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wind Fire Wheels (Ultimate)[/b]
Become CC immune and launch an enemy god into the air, executing a multi-hit combo with delayed damage. Perfect timing allows these hits to critically strike.
[b]+1:[/b] New visual presentation to make the QTE clearer.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Aspect of the Righteous Flame[/h3][p][i]Releasing February 13[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Righteous Spirit reworked[/b]
No longer builds from attacking. Instead, taking damage charges Righteous Spirit, granting a Heal over Time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Universe Ring Toss gains support utility[/b]
Ring Toss can now bounce to allies (including yourself), granting Movement Speed and Attack Speed buffs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flaming Spear Now Bonks[/b]
Becomes a damaging area attack that buffs Ne Zha’s basic attacks and consumes Righteous Spirit for a burst heal.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/2c89a4c7afa58fc0d84b20f9c2e90dbc075aab82.png"][/img][/p][p]By overwhelming community demand, [b]Anti-Heal is back[/b]. Core items like Divine Ruin, Brawler’s Beat Stick, and Stygian Anchor have been reworked to make countering sustain clearer, more reliable, and more impactful across all roles.[/p][p]Keep in mind: the new Anti-Heal is capped at 25%. It does not stack with other item Anti-Heal, or with the Anti-Heal that some Gods have built-in to their kit.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/d882bf8fdb2c241e1e1c16eee2e5f71d32e974c7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Jungle Practice has evolved into a shared playground.[/b] You can now launch Practice with friends and bots directly from Custom Lobbies. Experiment freely with builds, swap items anywhere on the map, control bot behavior, cycle objectives and camps, and test interactions without restrictions. Whether you’re theorycrafting, learning a god, or warming up with friends, Practice is now a true multiplayer tool.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/a8f695f5fcb2f200d08bdc524ef922266baaca25.png"][/img][/p][p]This weekend, celebrate Valentine’s Day the SMITE 2 way with a limited-time event full of rivalry and rewards:[/p][list][*][p]Play more games in a party to unlock the [b]Always Mine[/b] badge.[/p][/*][*][p]Play more games alone to claim the [b]Forever Alone[/b] badge.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/933fdcf1374b4510903105062726167622a48375.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/9f339421c6d38e2215612ad15660de4705b5ebbc.png"][/img][/p][p]To sweeten the deal, [b]2x Worshipers will be live for everyone this weekend[/b], and the Heartseeker Athena skin arrives just in time to break hearts and shields alike.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/e93021750fd3c6e7473230a0c3a7cd3d6998f064.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/44268b0d1a1360e1b07b88cc41d6f4eb3e76c5a1.png"][/img][/p][p]Two new Wandering Market Travelers (Oblivion Queen Discordia and Devil Punk Da Ji) also arrive as part of the ongoing [b]Reign of the Archfiend[/b], bringing fresh cosmetics, Wyrm Seals, and new progression toward event rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’re here to master a reborn god, test builds with friends, or prove your worth this Valentine’s weekend, the Battleground is ready.[/p][p]Happy Valentine’s? 🥀
We’ll see you in-game.

Full patch and balance notes are available at: [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-28-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-28-update-notes/[/url] [/p]

newsitems.title: NEW UPDATE: Joust Reforged and the Return of Chiron
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]Knowledge is power, and the Great Teacher has returned.[/p][p]The [b]Great Teacher Update[/b] welcomes [b]Chiron[/b] back to the battleground, totally reforges [b]Joust's visuals[/b], introduces the massive [b]Reign of the Archfiend[/b] event (including a Saga for Kukulkan), delivers a Ranked reset, and rolls out wide-ranging updates to game modes, visuals, systems, and balance. Whether you are climbing Ranked, chasing cosmetics, or jumping back in after a break, this update is packed with reasons to play.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]NEW CLASSIC GOD: CHIRON, THE GREAT TEACHER[/h3][p]Chiron blends precision damage, team utility, and clutch survivability into a uniquely flexible hunter playstyle.[/p][list][*][p][b]Herbal Medicine (Passive):[/b] Abilities consume charges to heal injured allies over time while granting bonus Strength and Intelligence, prioritizing the lowest-health ally nearby.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Training Exercise:[/b] Deploy a constellation that grants Crowd Control immunity to allies, then detonates for Physical Damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Masterful Shot:[/b] Mark enemies to reduce protections, then fire seeking arrows. [b]New +1s: [/b]At high Strength or Attack Speed thresholds, this ability evolves and gains powerful AoE Ground Target or rapid-fire variants.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Giddyup!:[/b] Gallop forward while dealing damage, displacing enemies, and firing attacks on the move. [b]New +1: [/b]You can now fire in any direction during this ability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Centaurus (Ultimate):[/b] Become a living constellation, firing wall-piercing arrows from afar. Chiron defies death during this ability and can revive himself by securing a kill.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Aspect of the Heroic Tutor[/b] arrives January 30, enhancing Chiron’s team-focused identity with an Enchanter Support-focused aspect. Marked enemies can be stunned, Training Exercise amplifies ally damage, and Centaurus transforms into a battlefield-wide support tool.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]NEW EVENT AND SAGA: REIGN OF THE ARCHFIEND[/h3][p]Reign of the Archfiend is a brand-new event inspired by Buy All events from SMITE 1, offering an incredible amount of cosmetic content at a heavily discounted price.[/p][p]For [b]8,000 Diamonds[/b], players can unlock [b]all Wandering Market cosmetic content released through the end of March[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Archfiend Saga Kukulkan[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Two Reward Travelers (Ra and Anhur, and Mordred)[/p][/*][*][p]Classic Travelers for eight gods (Da Ji, Discordia, Neith, Janus, Loki, Sol, Artio, and Tsukuyomi)[/p][/*][*][p]Premium Travelers for Jing Wei and Artemis[/p][/*][*][p]Additional titles, card effects, wards, and more[/p][/*][/list][p]Players who prefer individual purchases can still buy Travelers normally and earn [b]Wyrm Seals[/b] to unlock rewards over time, including the Archfiend Saga itself.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]THE ARCHFIEND SAGA[/h3][p]A massive Legendary Saga featuring exclusive skins, Prisms, kill effects, recalls, announcer pack, VXG animations, and themed cosmetics. The Archfiend Saga is only available through the event while it is active, with limited availability afterward.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]NEW WANDERING MARKET TRAVELERS[/h3][list][*][p][b]Dragonheart Rebel Jing Wei[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ra’nhur Best Friends Ra and Anhur[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Both Travelers include themed cosmetics.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]VISUAL AND MODE UPDATES[/h3][p][b]Joust Visual Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full lighting revamp[/p][/*][*][p]New jungle shadows and textures[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic skybox and environmental effects[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced atmosphere and map detail[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Multiqueue (Beta)[/b]
Queue simultaneously for Conquest, Arena, and Joust to find faster matches, especially in lower-population regions. [i]Note: This is a test of the technology, and only offers a single queue; in the future, we may add the ability to select which queues you Multiqueue for.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]RANKED RESET[/h3][p]This update introduces a harder Ranked reset with increased variance, compressing top players closer together and accelerating movement through ranks in the new split.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]QUALITY OF LIFE AND SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]New report option for players not playing their assigned role[/p][/*][*][p]Aspect descriptions now update dynamically in the God tab[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Daily Quests and XP rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer notification behavior across menus (easier to clear red dots)[/p][/*][*][p]HUD optimizations for smoother performance[/p][/*][*][p]Potion and chalice regen now cleanses when entering the fountain[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]BALANCE UPDATES ACROSS GODS AND ITEMS[/h3][p]The Great Teacher Update delivers sweeping balance changes across the roster and item shop, including buffs to underperforming gods, nerfs to outliers, item reworks, and clarity improvements across multiple systems. Balance notes are available here: [url="https://smiteprime.com/blog/10"]https://smiteprime.com/blog/10[/url][/p][hr][/hr][h2]LEARN. ADAPT. DOMINATE.[/h2][p]Chiron teaches by example, the Archfiend rises, and the battlefield evolves.[/p][p]Jump into [b]The Great Teacher Update[/b] and experience one of the most content-rich updates yet.[/p]

newsitems.title: Discordia Mage Carry Aspect: Live Jan. 16!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents: [p][b]Discordia's new Aspect of the Gilded Victor goes live January 16![/b][/p][p]This new Aspect redefines how Discordia plays, transforming the Goddess of Strife from a battlefield disruptor into a fast, aggressive attack damage dealer focused on pressure, momentum, and decisive victories.[/p][p]With [b]Aspect of the Gilded Victor[/b], Discordia’s passive is reworked so [i]Contest of Gods[/i] no longer shares power across the team. Instead, all of its offensive potential is focused directly into Discordia herself, converting Intelligence into raw Attack Damage. The result is a playstyle that rewards precision, positioning, and constant aggression.[/p][p][b]Unruly Magic[/b] no longer explodes on impact. Instead, the orb returns to Discordia, dealing damage again and granting a stack that empowers her next basic attacks to explode on hit. This creates new attack-based damage windows and encourages weaving basics between abilities for maximum payoff.[/p][p][b]Erratic Behavior[/b] trades its stealth field for a burst of Attack Speed and Attack Damage, pushing Discordia into close-range skirmishes where she can capitalize on her empowered attacks and snowball momentum through sustained pressure.[/p][p]Finally, [b]Golden Apple of Discord[/b] becomes faster and more focused. It no longer spreads its effect, but instead delivers quicker, more reliable crowd control and damage, allowing skilled players to punish key targets and swing fights in their favor.[/p][p]Aspect of the Gilded Victor is built for players who want to turn chaos into control, trade randomness for mastery, and dominate fights through aggressive execution.[/p][p]Log in on [b]January 16[/b], equip the Aspect, and experience a new way to play Discordia.[/p]

newsitems.title: Discordia Descends: Goddess of Strife Update
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]Chaos has a name, and it arrives on Jan. 13.[/p][p][b]The Goddess of Strife Update[/b] unleashes Discordia into the battleground, new Travelers, item and god balance shifts, and major performance and quality-of-life improvements. This patch sharpens the pace of matches, rewards aggression, and delivers one of the most disruptive gods yet.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]NEW GOD: DISCORDIA, GODDESS OF STRIFE[/h3][p]Discordia is a high-impact mage built around disruption, deception, and turning enemy teams against themselves.[/p][list][*][p][b]Contest of Gods (Passive):[/b] The top damage dealer on your team gains bonus Strength and Intelligence. [b]New +1:[/b] Discordia earns random temporary buffs through kills, assists, and leveling.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unruly Magic:[/b] A volatile orb that explodes, then fractures into bouncing projectiles for layered damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Strife:[/b] Punishes grouped enemies by forcing them to attack their nearest ally.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Erratic Behavior:[/b] Leap into chaos, gaining stealth, movement speed, and reduced cooldowns. [b]New +1:[/b]  Extending the stealth zone's lifespan through aggression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Golden Apple of Discord (Ultimate):[/b] A devastating crowd-control tool that cripples, trembles, and detonates enemies caught in its influence -- then spreads to affect nearby enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Aspect of the Gilded Victor [i](Live Jan. 16)[/i][/b] transforms Discordia into a more aggressive, attack-focused threat, altering her abilities for faster pressure, empowered attacks, and a deadlier Golden Apple.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]NEW WANDERING MARKET TRAVELERS[/h3][p][b]Corebreaker Ares[/b]
A brutal, forged warrior aesthetic with Prisms, Announcer Pack, Jump Stamp, and Ward Skin.[/p][p][b]Blind Vengeance Nemesis[/b]
A sleek assassin look featuring Urban Assassin, Night Sky, and Crimson Flame Prisms, plus new cosmetics and title.[/p][p][b]Crimson Mist Eset[/b]
A haunting new Traveler with themed cosmetics, animated badge, ward skin, and tracker.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]CONQUEST AND GAME MODE UPDATES[/h3][list][*][p]Base Teleporters now intelligently redirect if the target dies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fire Giant spawns 1m after Naga falls, down from 5m, accelerating late-game stakes.[/p][/*][*][p]Totem now grants a short but powerful global movement speed and mana regeneration buff.[/p][/*][*][p]Joust Quickplay minions spawn faster, increasing match tempo.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]ITEM AND META SHAKEUPS[/h3][list][*][p]Jungle starters receive targeted nerfs to curb early snowballing.[/p][/*][*][p]Lifesteal and crit interactions adjusted across multiple tiers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW: Spectral Visage[/b], a magical anti-crit defense option.[/p][/*][*][p]Major build path updates move several items toward clearer Attack Damage identities.[/p][/*][*][p]Relic and item UI clarity significantly improved, especially for controller users.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]GOD BALANCE HIGHLIGHTS[/h3][list][*][p]Buffs for Amaterasu, Anubis, Chaac, Hades, Hercules, Medusa, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Targeted nerfs for Da Ji and select high-performing items (Sanguine Lash, The Reaper, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Nut receives base buffs, with strong nerfs to her Aspect.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous fixes to clarity, scaling, and consistency across the roster.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]PERFORMANCE AND QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Massive physics memory cleanup, recovering over [b]500MB RAM[/b] in Conquest.[/p][/*][*][p]In-match HUD optimizations for reduced GPU usage, leading to smoother teamfights and camera movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Relic selection and item store navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]New Agility Relic keybind options.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced pause and surrender UI issues, especially on gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p]Pantheon Quests return as Yule Fest ends.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]THE BATTLEFIELD IS UNSTABLE.[/h2][p]Discordia thrives in chaos, Conquest moves faster, and every fight matters more than ever.[/p][p]Jump in, sow strife, and see who survives OB26.[/p][p][/p][p]Full Patch Notes will be available on Jan. 13 at [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/[/url][/p]

newsitems.title: Shotgun Kuku is Here!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents: [h3][b]Kukulkan is heading into the Jungle![/b][/h3][p]On January 2, we’re releasing the [b]Aspect of the Squall[/b], a complete reimagining of Kukulkan’s kit. This Aspect is designed for players who want to get up close and personal, trading long-range poke for devastating "shotgun" burst and aggressive utility.[/p][h3][b]♻️ NEW PASSIVE: SOUL OF THE SQUALL[/b] [/h3][p]Master the Jungle to fuel your power. You now gain permanent [b]Mana[/b] from:[/p][list][*][p]Jungle Monster kills[/p][/*][*][p]God kills and assists[/p][/*][*][p][i]Synergizes perfectly with Kukulkan's base passive to scale your late-game damage![/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🌪️ THE "SHOTGUN" KIT:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Zephyr (1):[/b] The range is shorter, but the punch is massive. You now fire [b]3 projectiles[/b] in a spread—land all three at point-blank range for a true "shotgun" blast.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slipstream (2):[/b] No longer just a speed boost. This ability is now [b]always a dash[/b] that steals Protections from any enemy you pass through, making you harder to kill while you shred your target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Whirlwind (3):[/b] Forget ground targets. Your Whirlwind now [b]attaches to YOU[/b], following you as you move before exploding in a blast that [b]knocks back[/b] all nearby enemies. Use it to engage or to peel for yourself mid-dive![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📅 Release Date:[/b] January 2, 2025[/h3][p]Whether you’re a long-time Kukulkan main looking for a fresh challenge or a Jungle specialist looking for a new high-burst pick, the [b]Aspect of the Squall[/b] is ready to blow the competition away.[/p][p]Prepare to dive in. See you on the Battleground! 🐍💨[/p]

newsitems.title: New Aspect: Support Nut!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents: [h2][b]Support Nut is Here![/b][/h2][p]On December 26, Nut’s playstyle expands with the [b]Aspect of the Cosmos[/b]. This Aspect trades raw damage scaling for massive utility, turning her from a backline Hunter into a protective powerhouse for her team.[/p][h3][b]✨ NEW PASSIVE: COSMIC FLUX[/b] [/h3][p]Your standard Flux is replaced with [b]Cosmic Flux[/b], focused on defense and restoration:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mitigation:[/b] Gain 0.75% Damage Mitigation per stack (up to 20 stacks).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing Skies:[/b] As your stacks decay (when above 10), you send out healing bolts to nearby allies, keeping your team in the fight longer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trade-off:[/b] Base Damage is increased by 20%, while Scaling is reduced by 20%.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🌌 ABILITY BREAKDOWN:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Convergence (1):[/b] Now a team-buffing tool! Hitting an enemy God grants a mini version of Convergence to your nearby allies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crashing Comet (2):[/b] Enhanced Crowd Control. The comet now [b]Stuns (!) and Slows[/b] enemies, making it a perfect tool for peeling or setting up kills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Warp (3):[/b] Your escape is now a save! Activating Warp grants [b]CC Immunity (!)[/b] to yourself and one nearby ally.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skyfall (Ult):[/b] Continue to dominate the skies with your signature pull, now bolstered by your Cosmic Flux mitigation.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📅 Release Date:[/b] December 26, 2025[/h3][p]Whether you're looking to pair her with Geb's new Carry Aspect for the ultimate Egyptian duo lane or want to experiment with a high-utility Ranged Support, the [b]Aspect of the Cosmos[/b] brings a whole new dimension to Nut.[/p][p]See you on the Battleground! [/p]

newsitems.title: HOLIDAY MEGAPATCH: Nut, 3 Aspects, Relic Overhaul, New Objectives, and More!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]The [b]Holiday Megapatch[/b] delivers one of the largest SMITE 2 updates to date. [b]Geb throws jets?[/b] You can now have [b]FOUR Relics?[/b] The [b]Enhanced Fire Giant[/b] returns? This update changes [b]EVERYTHING[/b]! Read on to learn all the details and prepare for the new era of SMITE 2.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]New God: Nut, Egyptian Goddess of the Sky[/h2][p][i]Hunter? Mage? Why not both?[/i][/p][p][i]Nut has arrived! Thanks to her hybrid scaling, you get to choose how you build and play her. Will you focus on attacks or ability damage?[/i][/p][list][*][p]Flux is now [b]Stellar [/b](Strength) or [b]Astral [/b](Int) based on the higher stat.[/p][list][*][p][b]Stellar [/b]builds from ability hits, and stacks now drain gradually (1 by 1).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Astral [/b]builds from basic hits; spending 4 stacks grants [b]20% bonus damage [/b]
and an extra effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]A01[/b] (Slight visual/timing changes): [b]Astral Bonus applies 15% Penetration[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]A02:[/b] [b]Astral Bonus triggers an "Echo"[/b] effect briefly afterward.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A03:[/b] Now deals more damage on the first projectile, improving AoE use.[/p][list][*][p][b]Stellar Effect: [/b]Resets A01 cooldown and grants [b]2 immediate shots of A01.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Astral Bonus: [/b]Fires [b]2 additional projectiles.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]A04[/b] (Ultimate): Camera and timing adjusted for a more [b]cinematic feel.[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]New Aspects[/h2][h3]Geb, Aspect of Calamity (Available Dec. 19)[/h3][p][i]Ever wanted to throw fighter jets at your enemies? Now you can![/i][/p][p][b][i]Geb becomes a Carry[/i][/b][i] with his completely-reworked Aspect of Calamity! Pair him with Nut's Support Aspect for the ultimate duo lane synergy.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Basic Attacks: [/b]Reworked to be [b]Ranged.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Deal decreasing damage (down to 20%) for each target passed through.[/p][/*][*][p]Travel [b]60% slower [/b]and have a [b]40% bigger hitbox [/b]than standard attacks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]A02 (Shockwave): [/b]Uses the old aspect version, but [b]now applies Attack Speed for Gods hit[/b] (instead of CDR).[/p][/*][*][p][b]A03 (Stone Shield):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Has [b]less shield health[/b] and is [b]Self Only[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]While active, your [b]Basic Attacks deal more damage.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]A04 (Cataclysm): Knocks Away[/b] enemies rather than stunning them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hey Cousin, Let’s Go Bowling![/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Nut, Aspect of the Cosmos (Available Dec. 26) [/h3][p][b][i]Support Nut[/i][/b][i] is REAL.[/i][/p][p][i]Aspect of the Cosmos introduces an all-new, support-focused playstyle for the Goddess of the Sky! Get access to a ranged stun and free CC immunity for an ally.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Now has [b]Cosmic Flux:[/b] Builds from both Basic/Ability Hits, stacks up to 20, and decays 1 at a time.[/p][list][*][p]Grants [b]0.75% Damage Mitigation per Stack.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Decaying stacks (above 10) send a[b] healing bolt[/b] to nearby allies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Base Damage +20%, Scaling -20%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A01[/b] hits apply a [b]mini version of A01 to allies.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]A02[/b] now [b]stuns/slows[/b] instead of rooting/trembling.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]A03[/b] grants [b]CC Immunity[/b] to herself and one nearby god (prioritizes CC'd allies).[/p][h3]Kukulkan, Aspect of the Squall (Available Jan. 2)[/h3][p][b][i]Shotgun Kukulkan?[/i][/b][i] Yes, you heard that right.[/i][/p][p][i]The new [b]Aspect of the Squall[/b] turns the Serpent into an unstoppable, close-range [b]burst damage Jungler[/b].[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Passive: [/b]Provides Mana on [b]Jungle monster kill [/b]and God kill/assist[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zephyr:[/b] Changes from 1 long-range projectile to [b]3 shorter-range projectiles[/b] (with 
subsequent damage reduction).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slipstream: Always a dash, [/b]but now [b]steals enemy protections.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Whirlwind:[/b] Cannot be cast at range; it [b]attaches to Kukulkan[/b], dealing burst damage, a lesser DoT, and a small knockback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Playstyle:[/b] Requires players to [b]commit to close-range for heavy damage.[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]New Relic Overhaul[/h2][p][b][i]One Relic not enough? How about FOUR?![/i][/b][/p][p][i]You can now upgrade your Relic into a powerful [b]Active Item[/b] with a stronger effect, and then buy a brand new Relic! Or you can keep your starting Relic and just buy a new Relic Active Item directly.[/i][/p][p][i]Keep in mind: Players are still limited to 3 Active Items, so purchasing a Relic Active Item means foregoing other Active Items. Additionally, Relic Active Items grant slightly lower stats than comparable items, in exchange for the power of their Actives.[/i][/p][h3]New Relic Items[/h3][list][*][p][b]Mote of Chaos[/b] (New Component): +5% Stats from Items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blinking Abyss [/b](New Active): Blink Teleports and deals AoE damage 1s later. God damage triggers Cooldown Reduction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Time-Lock Aegis [/b](New Active): Aegis Invulnerability for 3s (rooted); regenerates Health, Mana, and 10s Cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Talisman of Purification[/b] (Adjusted): Now grants Higher Cooldown Rate, +7.5% Stats from Items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Agility Greaves[/b] (New Active): Dash; grants Attack Projectile Speed (Ranged) or reduces Attack Movement Penalty (Melee) for 3s after use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sundering Arc[/b] (Rework): True Damage removed; Bleed now applies to all enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sundering Echo[/b] (New Active): Applies a strong Bleed; enemies who die explode and re-apply Bleed to nearby targets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shell of Rebuke[/b] (New Active): Creates a safe area that grants a defensive shield/phantom effect and mitigate damage.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]New Conquest Objectives[/h2][p][i]Side teleporters? Gone. Back camps? Gone.[/i][/p][p][i]We're updating the Conquest map layout to reduce excess farm and emphasize strategic rotations and decision-making![/i][/p][p][i]And that's not all: Objectives are changing too, with[/i] [/p][p][i]Enhanced Fire Giant is back! The action escalates with each Moonlight phase, bringing the Moonlight Queen, Ancient Fury, and EFG.[/i][/p][h3]Layout Changes[/h3][p]Side teleporters, back harpies, and back side oracles have been removed.[/p][h3]Moonlight Objective Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Winning the Moonlight Phase now resets base teleporter cooldowns.[/p][/*][*][p]Base teleporters will take you to Naga Lane Pushers, when the pushers are beyond your final tower.[/p][/*][*][p]Ritual of the Full Moon Shift now grants movement speed and enemy reveal only.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Second Night: Moonlight Queen[/h3][list][*][p][b]Spawns only once [/b]in the Fire Giant Pit during the second Moonlight Phase[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat the Moonlight Queen to claim valuable [b]permanent stat bonuses[/b] (+5% Strength and Intelligence) and a temporary team buff, [b]Ritual of Star Strike[/b], upon defeat. This ritual grants the Star Strike passive, which enables abilities to trigger a secondary [b]AoE explosion[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Third Night: Ancient Fury[/h3][list][*][p]Now spawns after the start of the third Moonlight Phase.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fourth Night: Enhanced Fire Giant[/h3][list][*][p]Fire Giant becomes Enhanced during the 4th Moonlight Phase, gaining significant health and power bonuses. Killing it grants Fire Giant’s Rage, which offers greatly increased Strength/Intelligence, doubled HP/MP regeneration, and [b]attacks bypass Backdoor Protections.[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]New Travelers and Cosmetics[/h2][h3]Aphrodite Yule Cheer Traveler[/h3][p]Includes Snowfall, Mistletoe, and Dark Noel Prisms and a Peppermint Candy.[/p][h3]Fenrir Wreck the Halls Traveler[/h3][p]Includes Frosty, Yule Napper, and Festive Filcher Prisms and a Peppermint Candy.[/p][h3]Jormungandr World Kitty Traveler[/h3][p]Includes Baron, Ginger, and Snowball Prisms and a Peppermint Candy.[/p][h3]Christmas Supporter Store Bundle[/h3][p]A collection of festive Name Flairs.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]UI and System Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Pause and Surrender widgets updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Anti-Leaver v1: Alt-F4 disabled in matchmaking, leaving requires a timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby improvements for pick and ban visibility and default god skin selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Various optimizations to chat window, prompts, and health bars.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Account Level Pacing Test[/h3][p]New XP pacing for early account levels aims to better match the length of Quickplay matches.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Additional Changes[/h2][list][*][p]NEW Active Item: Ragnarok’s Wake[/p][list][*][p]On Use: Choose a target location. After channeling for 2s, become a meteor and fly to that location, dealing heavy damage and knocking enemies straight up upon impact.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rework: Jade Scepter[/p][list][*][p]NEW: On Use: Place a jade current at a target location. After 1s it erupts, knocking away any god in the area, including allies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Buff: Scepter of Dominion[/p][list][*][p]Decreased Buildup time from 2s -> 1.5s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Jade Scepter reworked with a jade current eruption effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Scepter of Dominion buffed with faster buildup time.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hit sound feedback for Artio A01.[/p][/*][*][p]More fixes and polish.[/p][/*][/list][p]Additional balance notes will be available on Monday, Dec. 15.[/p]
