newsitems.title: ARTIO ARRIVES: The Bear Goddess Update
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]The Bear Goddess update delivers -- you guessed it -- [b]Artio[/b], the Bear Goddess, bringing a unique stance-switching kit, powerful protection shred, and flexible frontline control. This update also expands Yulefest with new Travelers, continues map improvements, and includes wide gameplay and balance adjustments across modes, gods, and items.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]New God: Artio, the Bear Goddess[/h2][p]Artio shifts between [b]Druid[/b] and [b]Bear[/b] stances, using each to pressure enemies, support allies, and chase down targets.[/p][list][*][p][b]Decompose (Passive):[/b] Damaging abilities apply protection reduction and healing reduction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Energy Surge / Maul Prey:[/b] Druid form pulses magic damage and heals nearby allies; Bear form swipes twice for close-range damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Entangling Vines / Ferocious Roar:[/b] Druid form cripples and reduces enemy power; Bear form stuns nearby enemies and boosts Artio’s defenses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Life Tap / Heavy Charge:[/b] Druid form drains enemies in a line, stacking slows into a root; Bear form charges forward, damaging and slowing enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shapeshift (Ultimate):[/b] Switch stances and gain Invigoration stacks for movement speed and mana regeneration whenever abilities hit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New +1s:[/b] Ranged attacks in Druid form, longer range healing, and hybrid scaling.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Aspect of the Denmother (Releasing December 5)[/h3][p]Artio can only change stances in the fountain but gains enhanced abilities when she leaves it. Her ultimate now changes depending on which stance she is in. It's Bearnado time![/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Wandering Market Travelers[/h2][h3]Knights of Osiris[/h3][p]Two heroic skins arrive with a comedic twist.
Includes [b]Noble Knight Osiris[/b], [b]Black Knight Osiris[/b], two Peppermint Candies, multiple Prisms, [b]Bloody Bunny[/b] Ward, and the [b]Noble[/b] and [b]Dark[/b] Titles.[/p][h3]Polar Prankster Danzaburou[/h3][p]A snow-throwing trickster celebrating the season.
Includes [b]Polar Prankster Danzaburou[/b], a Peppermint Candy, three Prisms, and an Announcer Pack.[/p][h3]Mystic Guardian Athena[/h3][p]A celestial defender from the stars.
Players who own any [b]Mystic Guardian Prisms[/b] unlock the Premium Page automatically. Includes the Skin, a Peppermint Candy, four Prisms, and the [b]Distance to Aid[/b] Tracker.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Game Modes and Map Updates[/h2][h3]Conquest[/h3][list][*][p]Base Teleporters now cancel automatically if the target tower is destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]Pyromancer no longer damages enemy structures on death.[/p][/*][*][p]Runic Bomb can no longer be destroyed by basic attacks and now bypasses backdoor protections.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Assault[/h3][p]Healers have been reorganized into three tiers based on overall team healing potential, reflecting differences between base kits and Aspects.[/p][h3]Quickplay Joust[/h3][p]Respawn times reduced across the board for faster pacing.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]God Balance Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]Sol:[/b] Immunity fix on Dissipate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aladdin:[/b] Stat scaling improved in late game, major boosts to Agile Run and Genie damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bellona:[/b] Reduced sustain and defensive power on Scourge and Eagle’s Rally.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cerberus:[/b] Increased damage on Paralyzing Spit, cooldown and soul changes to Soul Expulsion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Da Ji:[/b] Reduced scaling and lifesteal across multiple abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eset:[/b] Reduced scaling and healing on various abilities and Aspects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hades:[/b] Increased durability and improved scaling on Death From Below.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hun Batz:[/b] Reduced strength per passive stack.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jormungandr:[/b] Adjustments to base power and passive; World Serpent now grants stacking protections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kali, Medusa, Mulan, Osiris (Aspect), Pele, Princess Bari, Ra, Xbalanque[/b] all receive tuning changes across base kits and Aspects.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Item Balance Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]Talisman of Purification[/b] fix to ensure CC immunity works correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leather Cowl, Hunter’s Cowl, Sharpshooter’s Arrow[/b] receive buffs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dagger of Frenzy[/b] cost and scaling adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eye of Erebus[/b] cooldown and slow duration improved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Polynomicon[/b] now has an internal cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous changes across multiple items adjusting damage, costs, scaling, and consistency.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Step into battle with [b]Artio[/b], collect your Yulefest Candies, and explore a refreshed battleground as the season continues.[/p][p][/p][p]See the full update notes here: [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-24-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-24-update-notes/[/url][/p]

newsitems.title: Da Ji Arrives | The Nine-Tailed Fox Update
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]The Nine-Tailed Fox Update introduces [b]Da Ji[/b], a lethal assassin who brings bleeding attacks, rapid strikes, teleportation, and the iconic Paolao to Open Beta. Alongside her release, [b]Yulefest[/b] begins with free rewards, daily Advent Calendar logins, refreshed Wandering Market content, and new winter Travelers.
[/p][h2]New God: Da Ji[/h2][p]A fast and unforgiving executioner who thrives on pressure and bleed effects.[/p][list][*][p][b]Torture Blades (Passive):[/b] Attacks and abilities apply bleed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Horrible Burns:[/b] Empowers your next strike with bonus damage and a slow. Marked low health enemies reduce the cooldown and permanently increase its damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]One Thousand Cuts:[/b] Four rapid slashes with movement speed, rear damage mitigation, and freedom from strafe and backpedal penalties.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trickster Spirit:[/b] Teleport to an enemy or ward after a brief delay, damaging nearby foes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Paolao (Ultimate):[/b] Rise atop your Paolao, fire three snaring chains, and vortex enemies toward you. A second hit strengthens the pull, and enemies who reach the Paolao are stunned.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Aspect of Ferocity (Releasing Nov 21)[/b]
A more attack-focused take on Da Ji, trading burns for lifesteal, buffing One Thousand Cuts with Attack Speed, and gaining attack speed from Trickster Spirit.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Event: Yulefest[/h2][p]Earn winter rewards by collecting [b]Peppermint Candies[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Two Candies are free: one from the Advent Calendar and one on the Wandering Market Path.[/p][/*][*][p]Yulefest Travelers automatically grant their Candies upon purchase.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Candy Milestones:[/b][/p][list][*][p]2 Candies: Festive Title[/p][/*][*][p]3 Candies: Aladdin Winter's Wish Skin[/p][/*][*][p]4 Candies: Happy YuleFest 2025 Card Effect[/p][/*][*][p]6 Candies: Scylla Snow Day Skin and Traveler[/p][/*][/list][h3]Yulefest Advent Calendar[/h3][p]Available until December 26. Login daily to claim free rewards including diamonds, chests, and more.[/p][h3]Wandering Market Refresh[/h3][p]A new track of entirely free rewards is now active. All players start at Wandering Market Level 1 while keeping all previously earned Coins.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Yulefest Travelers[/h2][h3]Knit-Wit Anubis[/h3][p]The God of the Afterlife arrives bundled in winter warmth.
Includes Knit-Wit Skin with VXG, a Peppermint Candy, three Prisms, an Announcer Pack, and a Holiday Recall.[/p][h3]Darkest Knight Xbalanque[/h3][p]A moonlit hunter sworn to winter justice.
Includes Darkest Knight Skin, Peppermint Candy, three Prisms, and a Title.[/p][h3]Royal Blue Pele[/h3][p]A frost-crowned dancer wreathed in sapphire flame.
Includes Moonlit Flame Pele, Peppermint Candy, Animated Badge, Card Effect, and dual Titles.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Supporter Store[/h2][p][b]SMITE Kart Teleporter Effects[/b] are now available for purchase, bringing drifting flair.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Quality of Life and New Player Improvements[/h2][h3]Conquest Map Updates[/h3][list][*][p]New jungle lighting for stronger atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished materials, improved stealth grass, and refined lighting across major landmarks.[/p][/*][*][p]Subtle god rays on Medium and higher settings.[/p][/*][/list][h3]General Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Player Badge display added to friend and custom menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Wandering Market music restored.[/p][/*][*][p]New Yulefest event music.[/p][/*][*][p]Various audio fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Game Mode Balance Highlights[/h2][h3]Conquest[/h3][list][*][p]Pathfinder buff reworked with sustain moved to Jungle Starters.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted kill reward formulas to reduce swinginess and early snowball.[/p][/*][*][p]Respawn duration per level reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Base Teleporter cooldown increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Moonlight Ritual site shard spawn improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Lane Minion movement and targeting improvements for smoother combat.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Assault[/h3][p]Reduced early respawn times, faster overtime scaling, and shorter Teleporter cooldown.[/p][h3]Arena[/h3][p]Ticket count increased from 400 to 425.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Item Balance Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]Potions and Chalice rebalanced with longer durations and lower instant healing.[/p][/*][*][p]Elixirs reworked to prevent stacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Agility Relic cooldown increased and now prevents ability use while dashing.[/p][/*][*][p]Full Bumba’s overhaul for clearer jungle item roles.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple item reworks including Sanguine Lash, Lifebinder, Devourer’s Gauntlets, The Reaper, and Sphere of Negation.[/p][/*][*][p]Comprehensive Anti-Heal item pass introducing new role-focused options for tanks, mids, carries, and junglers.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]God Balance Highlights[/h2][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Ranged Basic Attack speeds standardized to smooth out cross-class consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]Wide adjustments to leap timings for multiple gods.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased healing for Aphrodite, Guan Yu, and Ra.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ranged Supports[/h3][p]Targeted nerfs for Baron Samedi, Yemoja, and Eset to reduce early pressure.[/p][h3]Aladdin Soft Rework[/h3][p]Large adjustments across his kit to improve clarity, reduce frustration, and raise overall viability.[/p][h3]Additional Changes[/h3][p]Bellona, Osiris, and others receive tuning based on role performance and item changes.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Step into the winter battlefield, master Da Ji’s ferocity, and celebrate Yulefest with new rewards, Travelers, and balance updates across all modes.

For full update notes, visit [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-23-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-23-update-notes/[/url][/p]

11/6 Hotfix[/p][list][*][p]Fixed Rama unable to cancel ability 1 and 3 with right-click/right-bumper.[/p][/*][*][p]As a result we had to revert Rama Aspect + Agility gamepad fix where you would be unable to use agility. newsitems.title: The Keeper of the Wild Update is LIVE NOW!
newsitems.author: [cq]alakath
newsitems.contents:
[p]Open Beta 22 brings the [b]Keeper of the Wild Update[/b], introducing the forest guardian [b]Sylvanus[/b], improved Conquest Lighting, new Wandering Market Travelers, quality-of-life improvements, and the start of [b]Pantheon Quests[/b].[/p][h2]New God: Sylvanus, Keeper of the Wild[/h2][p]Command the power of nature through seeds, flowers, and vines.[/p][list][*][p][b]Nature’s Bounty (Passive):[/b] Picking up seed pods restores mana and reduces cooldowns.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Verdant Growth:[/b] Throw pods that root enemies or grow flowers for ally mana regen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wisps:[/b] Heal allies or damage enemies, reviving or empowering flowers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nature’s Grasp:[/b] Pull enemies or pods toward you; below 40% health, consume pulled pods for Wisps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wrath of Terra (Ultimate):[/b] Slam the ground, dealing continuous damage and knocking up foes.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Aspect of Grover’s Wrath (Releasing Nov 7)[/b]
Sylvanus gains increased attack speed and damage to debuffed enemies while trading some healing for aggression. Build Anger stacks to unleash Enrage and empower his grasp of nature, now a Tether instead of a Pull.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Wandering Market Travelers[/h2][p][b]Dark Lord Sun Wukong[/b]
From the ashes of forgotten empires, the Dark Lord rises again.
Includes the [b]Dark Lord Skin[/b] plus Obsidian, Voidspawn, and Frostbane Prisms, [b]Godslayer Jump Stamp[/b], and [b]Dark Lord Title[/b].[/p][p][b]Sacred Arrow Rama[/b]
With virtue and divine precision, Rama pierces the darkness.
Includes the [b]Sacred Arrow Skin[/b] plus Cursed Wraith, Starbound, and Infernal Menace Prisms, [b]Heaven’s Shower Jump Stamp[/b], and [b]Sacred Arrow Badge[/b].[/p][p][b]Soul Piercer Achilles[/b]
If you own any [b]Soul Piercer Prisms[/b], instantly unlock the Premium Page.
Includes [b]Soul Piercer Skin[/b], three Prisms, the [b]Flowers Received Tracker[/b], and [b]Soul Piercer Title[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Quality of Life & Gameplay Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]Pantheon Quests:[/b] Complete new challenges in the Events tab to earn Pantheon Badges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Lighting:[/b] Enhanced visuals in the lobby and Conquest map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio Updates:[/b] Improved effects for Thanatos’ basics and the Conquest day/night cycle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ward Timers:[/b] Wards now show a countdown on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jungle Practice:[/b] Added “Add Item Stacks” option for testing.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]God Balance Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]Amaterasu[/b] shifted for more consistent damage and reduced early scaling.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aphrodite[/b], [b]Chaac[/b], [b]Nu Wa[/b], [b]Thor[/b], and [b]Tsukuyomi[/b] receive buffs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eset[/b], [b]Hua Mulan[/b], [b]Mercury[/b], [b]Osiris[/b], and [b]Xbalanque[/b] see targeted nerfs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sobek[/b] and [b]Scylla[/b] receive tuning and fixes.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Item Balance Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]Chandra’s Grace[/b] adjusted for shorter cooldown buff windows.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Daybreak Gavel[/b], [b]Dagger of Frenzy[/b], [b]Eye of Erebus[/b], and [b]Shield Splitter[/b] strengthened.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leviathan’s Hide[/b], [b]Screeching Gargoyle[/b], and [b]Stone of Binding[/b] improved for better reliability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Executioner[/b] reduced in cost for smoother builds.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Take root and restore balance with [b]Sylvanus, Keeper of the Wild[/b]. Explore new Travelers, chase Pantheon rewards, and discover how nature reshapes the battlefield.

The full update notes are available here: [url="https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-22-update-notes/"]https://www.smite2.com/news/open-beta-22-update-notes/[/url][/p]
